description: Contract for request_npc_depth: a player-side application asks the Court (world-mind) for depth intelligence about an NPC — their thoughts, motivations, and plans. The Court may refuse, in which case it returns a first-class refusal instructing the mechanics to fall back to plain Python execution.

request.description: The client's request for NPC depth intelligence.

npc_id.description: Identifier for the NPC whose depth intelligence is requested.

context_summary.description: Summary of the current situation and recent events relevant to this NPC. Maximum 500 characters.

distress.description: Advisory hint only: client believes this NPC may be in distress. The Court decides whether to refuse; this field is not a claim.

oneOf.description: Depth intelligence returned by the Court.

refused.description: Always false in a depth reply.

text.description: Court-generated intelligence: the NPC's thoughts, motivations, or plans.

oneOf.description: The Court refuses to provide depth intelligence.

refused.description: Always true in a refusal reply.

reason.description: Why the Court refused. distress: NPC is too damaged or overwhelmed; rate_limit: too many requests in a short time; unreachable: Court infrastructure down.

fallback.description: Instruction to fall back to simple Python execution without depth intelligence.
